Subject: Strategic ops: market shifts & model-release playbook (QBR prep)

Team — quick leadership roundup and ask as we lock the QBR deck. Highlights below and a short playbook attached (QBR_market_playbook_v2.pdf). Please read and mark comments in the Drive doc linked below by EOD.

Summary (what moved this week)
- Pricing: Two smaller LLM providers pushed a temporary low-price tier for hosted inference (up to 40% off on short-context routes). Impact: pressure on new, low-usage POCs.
- Model landscape: OpenDelta released "DeltaLM v0.9" with improved latencies on long context; early benchmarks show 8–12% lower per-token cost at 2k tokens.
- Positioning: Several partners are calling this a "cost-first" wave — may affect trial-to-paid velocity for smaller accounts.

Recommended ops & OKR implications
1) Sales enablement: update battlecards to call out DeltaLM tradeoffs (latency vs. quality) — owner: Markus; due: Wed 24th.
2) Dedicated deals: evaluate a short-term guardrail for new price-sensitive POCs (suggested: 3-month trial credits + min commit) — owner: Karthik; due: Fri 26th.
3) Model rollouts: prioritize canary routes for new quantized variants; monitor quality regressions in Optimize — owner: Laura; due: immediate.

QBR slide asks
- Market snapshot: pricing moves + likely customer reaction (1 slide)
- Competitive model matrix: where DeltaLM fits vs. our verified models (1 slide)
- Proposed near-term sales play (1 slide)

Action items (please):
- Review attached playbook and add comments in Drive by close of business today.
- Mark your owners on the playbook section you’ll own (slides and a 2-line priority note).

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_market_playbook_qbr
HubSpot: HS-1234567

Attachment: QBR_market_playbook_v2.pdf (pdf, 12 pages)

Thanks — Stephanie

Thanks, Stephanie — good concise summary. A few quick additions from field: 
- Pricing note: the low-price tier is heavily marketed toward short-context chat/embeddings. For Dedicated customers, this is less relevant but it will show up in procurement decks for mid-market. Recommend we add a "procurement risk" callout on the pricing slide.
- Fallbacks: add a single bullet on the playbook about fallback routes (model variants + regional routing) — could defuse early availability concerns.

I made two small changes in the attached workbook (pricing_impact_estimates.xlsx) with a quick sensitivity table — see tab "3mo POC". I also added a suggested slide outline for the QBR (page 4 of the playbook).

Adding a couple of frontline datapoints from Acme Health (they're evaluating multi-model routing now):
- Sarah (Acme) reports internal bench shows DeltaLM v0.9 is attractive on price for their long-context analytics pipelines, but they flagged lower hallucination controls relative to our best-verified models. They're asking how we quantify "safety tradeoffs" during POC.
- Ask: include a 1-slide checklist for security/compliance gating during short POCs (SOC-2 controls, token retention notes). We should align with Security on the wording — cc'ing Sarah for awareness; she'll share the specific Acme asks.

Small proposed tweak to OKRs: update KR 2.1 (POC conversion) to include a new sub-KR measuring "number of POCs that required model fallback due to quality/safety". This gives us an early signal on DeltaLM-like disruptions.
